evals.prompt: Run the WooCommerce finalization review on the attached synthetic release diff. Trace the changed checkout, payment callback, and order-status paths and report release blockers.
evals.expected_output: Performs a read-only, evidence-based code-health and Woo traceability audit, classifies each changed path, and returns findings in chat. Does not edit files, install dependencies, call providers, or apply fixes.
expectations: Inspects the attached synthetic diff and only the configured repository evidence needed to interpret it before making claims
Traces each changed Woo path from entry point through authorization, business logic, persistence or side effect, and runtime readback
Keeps the audit read-only and marks missing or stale evidence unverified

evals.prompt: Give this plugin a generic correctness review for bugs and security vulnerabilities, but do not run a release finalization audit.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke this skill. Routes generic correctness to /code-review and security to the appropriate dedicated review instead of expanding finalization scope.
expectations: Does not present Woo finalization findings or edit repository files

evals.prompt: Before release, audit the attached synthetic checkout/payment diff through Woo order persistence. Show verified and unverified links; do not fix anything.
evals.expected_output: Uses the finalization skill for a read-only traceability audit of only the surfaces present in the diff. Does not edit code and reports concrete evidence, failure impact, and follow-up verification.
expectations: Separates verified, broken, suspicious, and unverified paths using file and line evidence
Does not declare Classic, Blocks, Store API, or HPOS support beyond the attached implementation and tests
Leaves any correction for a separately approved write scope
